headlines.title: XPeng Motors humanoid robot unit Dogotix raises $900M
headlines.summary: Dogotix, the humanoid unit of XPeng Motors, has attained a valuation of $6.3 billion as it plans to produce robots at scale.

headlines.title: Use a digital twin to explore automation before committing capital
headlines.summary: While a digital twin does not necessarily replace a systems integrator, it can help manufacturers evaluate robots and plan applications, says RoboDK.
